title: PsiQuantum Finalizes $100M CHIPS Act Award With US Department of Commerce
detail: PsiQuantum executed a definitive $100 million award agreement with the US Department of Commerce under the CHIPS and Science Act, converting a Letter of Intent signed in May 2026 into direct capital co-investment. The funding backs domestic manufacturing of the photonic components underlying PsiQuantum's fault-tolerant architecture — 300mm-wafer barium titanate optical switches, high-temperature single-photon detectors, and automated chip-to-fiber packaging — at its PsiFactory assembly facility in Milpitas, California, strengthening onshore semiconductor supply chains for quantum computing.

title: IonQ Debuts Superion 256, Its Sixth-Generation Trapped-Ion Platform
detail: IonQ unveiled the Superion 256 at its 2026 Investor Day, a 256-physical-qubit trapped-ion system built on its 'Walking Cat' architecture with Electronic Qubit Control (EQC) and CMOS integration replacing laser-based control, designed as the first entry in a Superion product line meant to scale to 10,000+ qubits. Developed with subsidiary SkyWater Technology, the design-to-fabrication cycle compressed from roughly nine months to two, and the system is built to fit standard data-center server racks at a fraction of the power draw of a comparable GPU rack. IonQ is taking orders now, with customer deliveries targeted for 2027, while a separate fault-tolerant Superion 10K platform is in development.
